239:67603.name: DS Pagination
239:67603.description:
One pagination bar for a table. Sits inside the card, below the table, on a top hairline.

Left: rows per page. Right: the range, then previous / current page / next.

Surfaces are cream-elevated on qpay/border; the current page is a charcoal fill. Type is text-caption and text-footnote.

187:45814.name: DS Avatar Person
187:45814.description:
A person avatar with a photo, memoji, illustration, initials or icon, at nine sizes (80 → 20) with optional top and bottom status badges.

Use this when a real person is represented. For the initials-only chip in dense table rows, DS Avatar stays the lighter choice.

Palette: solid backgrounds and initials use the Ledger Calm families — tan (neutral), peach, blue, sky, violet and red, light tint behind a deep-tier letter. The verified badge is qpay/sky; the online badge is qpay/sky-green. Nothing here is a raw hex.

Type: initials follow the local scale — text-title at 80/72/64, text-headline at 56/48, text-callout at 40, text-caption at 32/24/20.

239:77082.name: DS Stepper
239:77082.description:
A horizontal step sequence for a multi-step flow. Current=1…5.

Done carries a check in a charcoal-outlined dot; the current step is a charcoal fill with its number in cream-elevated; upcoming steps are outlined in border-strong with an ink-subtle number. Separators are DS Chevron at 55%. Labels are text-caption and editable per instance.

Use this instead of hand-building a stepper. DS Step Progress is the five-segment bar for a different job.
